quests.correctAnswer: Soufflé Chaud de Fromage Blanc avec Sauce aux Cerises, Blanc de Volaille Farci aux Morilles avec Crème de Cerfeuil, Granité au Sauternes
quests.hint: Fromage blanc is a fresh French soft cheese - lighter than cream cheese.
quests.explanation: Fromage blanc (white cheese) is a very light fresh French cheese - used in both savoury and sweet preparations. A warm cheese soufflé with cherry sauce is an unusual and elegant combination. Cerfeuil is chervil - a delicate anise-flavoured herb essential in French fine cooking. Granité au Sauternes is a semi-frozen dessert of Sauternes wine.

quests.explanation: Galette de sarrasin (buckwheat crêpe) is the savoury Breton crêpe - used for savoury fillings while wheat crêpes are for sweet ones. Poulet fermier is certified free-range chicken. En croûte de sel seals the bird in a salt crust. Sauce diable is a spicy French sauce with mustard. Haute couture in desserts means an elaborately crafted presentation.
